build_vizwiz_dataset: build a VizWiz dataset builder that extends VQA2Builder for visual question answering on VizWiz images
create_vizwiz_builder_instance: create a VizWizBuilder instance that sets the dataset name to vizwiz and registers VizWizDataset
get_vizwiz_config_path: get the default YAML config path for the VizWiz dataset from the builder class
update_registry_for_vizwiz_model: update the MMF registry with VizWiz text vocab size and answer processor outputs for a model
register_vizwiz_builder: register the VizWizBuilder class under the name vizwiz in the MMF dataset builder registry
